package main

import "testing"

func TestDescribe(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct{ expr, want string }{
		{"* * * * *", "every minute"},
		{"*/15 * * * *", "every 15 minutes"},
		{"*/30 * * * *", "every 30 minutes"},
		{"0 * * * *", "at minute 0 of every hour"},
		{"0,30 * * * *", "at minutes 0 and 30 of every hour"},
		{"30 2 * * *", "at 02:30, every day"},
		{"0 9 * * MON-FRI", "at 09:00, on Monday through Friday"},
		{"0 0 1 * *", "at 00:00, on day 1 of the month"},
		{"0 0 1 1 *", "at 00:00, on day 1 of the month, in January"},
		{"0 0 15 * MON", "at 00:00, on day 15 of the month or on Monday"},
		{"0 12 1,15 JAN,JUL *", "at 12:00, on days 1 and 15 of the month, in January and July"},
		{"*/15 9-17 * * *", "at minutes 0, 15, 30 and 45 past hours 9 through 17"},
		{"@hourly", "at minute 0 of every hour"},
		{"@daily", "at 00:00, every day"},
		{"@weekly", "at 00:00, on Sunday"},
		{"@monthly", "at 00:00, on day 1 of the month"},
		{"@yearly", "at 00:00, on day 1 of the month, in January"},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		s := mustParse(t, c.expr)
		if got := s.Describe(); got != c.want {
			t.Errorf("Describe(%q):\n got %q\nwant %q", c.expr, got, c.want)
		}
	}
}
EOF
